title: Known network list profiles
whyItMatters: This key records every network the machine has joined, including SSIDs and gateways. It reveals where the computer has been connected.
source: Windows Network List service registry: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/netlistmgr/nn-netlistmgr-inetworklistmanager (NetworkList\Profiles subkeys, well-known forensic artifact)
notes: HKLM machine-wide key; individual per-network GUID subkeys are counted but their values are not read. Registry last-write time is unavailable.

steps: Forget the Wi-Fi networks you no longer use in Settings > Network & internet > Wi-Fi > Manage known networks.
Do not edit this list in Registry Editor; Windows manages it, and the full reset clears the network history named in the plan.
cleanup.risk: Windows keeps this list itself. Forgetting networks in Settings is enough, and the full reset clears the rest.
